# Anthropic

> > Anthropic develops Claude, an AI assistant built with Constitutional AI and advanced safety research, offering models through Claude.ai, Anthropic API, and Amazon Bedrock.

Anthropic is an AI safety company founded by Daniela Amodei and former OpenAI researchers, focused on building reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. The company conducts cutting-edge research in alignment, mechanistic interpretability, and societal impacts while deploying Claude models for enterprise, government, and consumer applications through partnerships and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

## Key Topics

- Claude (AI assistant family including Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Claude Opus 3, Claude 3.5 Haiku)
- Constitutional AI and AI safety research
- Model Context Protocol (MCP)
- Claude Code and agentic AI systems
- Anthropic API and Amazon Bedrock integration
- AI alignment and mechanistic interpretability
- Societal impacts and real-world AI use
- Computer use capability (beta)
- Claude.ai consumer platform
- National security and Claude Gov models
- Prompt engineering best practices
- Labs organization and experimental products
- Transparency and responsible AI practices
- Claude Partner Network
- AI education and fluency initiatives

## Claude Models & Core Products

- [Introducing computer use, a new Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Claude 3.5 Haiku](https://www.anthropic.com/news/3-5-models-and-computer-use): Claude 3.5 Sonnet refresh, Haiku launch, and computer use beta capability
- [An update on our model deprecation commitments for Claude Opus 3](https://www.anthropic.com/research/deprecation-updates-opus-3): Claude Opus 3 deprecation policy update and model preservation approach
- [Claude Gov models for U.S. national security customers](https://www.anthropic.com/news/claude-gov-models-for-u-s-national-security-customers): Claude Gov launch for U.S. national security & classified environments

## AI Safety & Research

- [Alignment Research](https://www.anthropic.com/research/team/alignment): Alignment team researching AI safety, reward tampering, and oversight methods
- [Societal Impacts Research](https://www.anthropic.com/research/team/societal-impacts): Societal Impacts team researching real-world AI use & Constitutional AI
- [Evaluating and Mitigating Discrimination in Language Model Decisions](https://www.anthropic.com/research/evaluating-and-mitigating-discrimination-in-language-model-decisions): Research on evaluating & mitigating bias in Claude 2.0 high-stakes decisions
- [In-context Learning and Induction Heads](https://www.anthropic.com/research/in-context-learning-and-induction-heads): Research on in-context learning mechanisms and induction heads in transformers
- [Developing nuclear safeguards for AI through public-private partnership](https://www.anthropic.com/news/developing-nuclear-safeguards-for-ai-through-public-private-partnership): DOE/NNSA partnership creating 96% accurate nuclear content classifier
- [Clio: Privacy-preserving insights into real-world AI use](https://www.anthropic.com/research/clio): Clio system for privacy-preserving analysis of Claude.ai usage patterns

- [AI Learning Resources & Guides from Anthropic](https://www.anthropic.com/learn): Educational hub with Claude guides, tutorials, and Anthropic Academy

- [Anthropic partners with Rwandan Government and ALX to bring AI education to hundreds of thousands of learners across Africa](https://www.anthropic.com/news/rwandan-government-partnership-ai-education): Rwanda & ALX partnership deploying Chidi AI education across Africa
